originalScenario.originalTextUnchanged: EV6-06-A: Roll 10d6 = 35, giving 75 force. The selected living target has effective maximum 100, current 50 HP, 10 temporary HP and no defenses/sharing; its actual Wound save has no fatal outcome. Post-temp damage is 65, and 65 minus 50 = 15 is below its maximum, so Core Instant Death does not apply. An eligible Death Ward prevents its positive-to-zero crossing and leaves it at 1 HP; the temporary HP is spent and the ward ends. The Disintegrate rider does not destroy that surviving body. Without an eligible prevention/replacement, the same target reaches zero from this packet, is disintegrated and dies; its separately owned sword remains.

originalScenario.originalTextUnchanged: EV6-06-A: Roll 10d6 = 35, giving 75 force. The selected living target has effective maximum 100, current 50 HP, 10 temporary HP and no defenses/sharing; its actual Wound save has no fatal outcome. Post-temp damage is 65, and 65 minus 50 = 15 is below its maximum, so Core Instant Death does not apply. An eligible Death Ward prevents its positive-to-zero crossing and leaves it at 1 HP; the temporary HP is spent and the ward ends. The Disintegrate rider does not destroy that surviving body. Without an eligible prevention/replacement, the same target reaches zero from this packet, is disintegrated and dies; its separately owned sword remains.

originalScenario.originalTextUnchanged: EV6-06-A: Roll 10d6 = 35, giving 75 force. The selected living target has effective maximum 100, current 50 HP, 10 temporary HP and no defenses/sharing; its actual Wound save has no fatal outcome. Post-temp damage is 65, and 65 minus 50 = 15 is below its maximum, so Core Instant Death does not apply. An eligible Death Ward prevents its positive-to-zero crossing and leaves it at 1 HP; the temporary HP is spent and the ward ends. The Disintegrate rider does not destroy that surviving body. Without an eligible prevention/replacement, the same target reaches zero from this packet, is disintegrated and dies; its separately owned sword remains.

fixturePremises: Actual body dimensions, positions, ordinary terrain, consent, language and initial injury/stock are finite NEW scene facts, not campaign authentication or free class acquisition.

Optional reactions, Matrix modifications, focused stance, Tether, feedback opportunities, Arrow/class riders not triggered and resource vents are declined unless actually recorded. Mandatory real source triggers are not waived.

branches.description: Full sourced Null exposure, actual Dimension Door transport and real paid setup, with actual Cultist would-die mark. Null never spends its interception on skipped death.

originalScenario.originalTextUnchanged: EV6-06-A: Roll 10d6 = 35, giving 75 force. The selected living target has effective maximum 100, current 50 HP, 10 temporary HP and no defenses/sharing; its actual Wound save has no fatal outcome. Post-temp damage is 65, and 65 minus 50 = 15 is below its maximum, so Core Instant Death does not apply. An eligible Death Ward prevents its positive-to-zero crossing and leaves it at 1 HP; the temporary HP is spent and the ward ends. The Disintegrate rider does not destroy that surviving body. Without an eligible prevention/replacement, the same target reaches zero from this packet, is disintegrated and dies; its separately owned sword remains.

originalScenario.originalTextUnchanged: EV6-06-A: Roll 10d6 = 35, giving 75 force. The selected living target has effective maximum 100, current 50 HP, 10 temporary HP and no defenses/sharing; its actual Wound save has no fatal outcome. Post-temp damage is 65, and 65 minus 50 = 15 is below its maximum, so Core Instant Death does not apply. An eligible Death Ward prevents its positive-to-zero crossing and leaves it at 1 HP; the temporary HP is spent and the ward ends. The Disintegrate rider does not destroy that surviving body. Without an eligible prevention/replacement, the same target reaches zero from this packet, is disintegrated and dies; its separately owned sword remains.

wholeCaseQualification.premises: Use exactly unchanged W13, W3 and Cult16 actor templates; new positions, an initially healthy W3 body and one independently recorded mundane sword are declared finite scene facts. All subsequent HP loss and protection come from the actual paid source events. No original EV6-06-A target/50HP/10buffer obligation is replaced.

originalScenario.originalTextUnchanged: EV6-06-A: Roll 10d6 = 35, giving 75 force. The selected living target has effective maximum 100, current 50 HP, 10 temporary HP and no defenses/sharing; its actual Wound save has no fatal outcome. Post-temp damage is 65, and 65 minus 50 = 15 is below its maximum, so Core Instant Death does not apply. An eligible Death Ward prevents its positive-to-zero crossing and leaves it at 1 HP; the temporary HP is spent and the ward ends. The Disintegrate rider does not destroy that surviving body. Without an eligible prevention/replacement, the same target reaches zero from this packet, is disintegrated and dies; its separately owned sword remains.
